info.name: Maham Customer API v1
info.description:
# Maham Customer API (v1)

**Base URL**: `{{base_url}}` (local: `http://maham.test/api/v1`)

## Headers on every request
- `Accept: application/json`
- `Accept-Language: ar` or `en` (messages, validation errors and content come back in this language)
- `Authorization: Bearer {token}` on protected endpoints

## Response format
Success: `{ "success": true, "message": "...", "data": {...} }`

Error: `{ "success": false, "message": "first error to show the user", "errors": { "field": ["..."] } }`

Status codes: 200 OK, 401 not logged in / token expired, 403 forbidden, 404 not found, 422 validation error, 429 too many requests / OTP resend too soon, 503 SMS provider down.

## Registration flow & next_step
Every auth response contains `next_step`. Open the screen for that value:
- `verify_phone` -> Phone number screen (Google/Apple users: use **Phone (social users)** endpoints)
- `personal_details` -> Tell us about yourself
- `credentials` -> Secure your account (email + password)
- `verify_email` -> Verify Email OTP sheet
- `address` -> Where should we find you?
- `profile_image` -> Add a profile photo
- `completed` -> Home
- `guest` -> Home in guest mode

If the user closes the app mid sign-up, call `GET /auth/me` on launch and open the `next_step` screen.

## Phone numbers
Send any Saudi format: `0512345678`, `512345678` or `+966512345678`. The API returns `phone` as `512345678` and `phone_country_code` as `+966`.

## OTP
**Demo account (local)**: demo@maham.sa / Demo1234 / phone 0500000001.

4 digits, valid 5 minutes, resend after 60 seconds (values also returned by `/app/config`). **On the local/staging server the OTP is always `1234`.**

request.description:
Call on the Splash screen.

- `data.update`: `force` = block the app and open `versions.{platform}.store_url`; `optional` = show "update available"; `none` = continue.
- `data.maintenance_mode`: show maintenance screen when true.
- `data.languages`: options for the Choose language screen (`direction` rtl/ltr).
- `data.otp`: OTP length and timers.

The chosen language is kept on the device and sent as `Accept-Language` on every request.
Onboarding 1-4 screens. Returns title, description and image_url in the requested language, already sorted.
Linked from "By creating an account, you agree to Maham's Terms of Service". `content` is HTML.
Linked from the sign-up screen. `content` is HTML.

"What's your phone number?" -> Next. Shows "Sending OTP" then "We just sent you an OTP".

Also used for "Resend OTP" (allowed after `resend_in` seconds, otherwise 429).

Error 422 on `phone` if the number already has an account (show message, go to Login).

OTP sheet -> Verify. On success shows "Phone Verified".

Returns `token` (saved automatically in Postman) + `next_step`. Use this token for all next steps.

`device_name`, `fcm_token`, `platform` are optional (for push notifications).
Optional live check while typing the username. `data.available` true/false.

"Tell us about yourself".

- `username`: 3-30 chars, letters/numbers/_/. (saved lowercase)
- `national_id`: 10 digits, starts with 1 (Saudi ID) or 2 (Iqama), checksum validated.

"Secure your account". Password: min 8 chars, at least one letter and one number.

Automatically emails a verification code -> open "Verify Email" sheet.
"Didn't receive OTP? Resend" on the Verify Email sheet.
Verify Email sheet -> Verify. Shows "Email Verified".
"Select City" dropdown.
"Select District" dropdown, after a city is chosen.
"Where should we find you?". `postal_code` (5 digits), `latitude`, `longitude` are optional.

"Add a profile photo" -> Submit details. multipart/form-data with `avatar` (jpg/png/webp, max 5 MB).

Shows "Your account has been created successfully".
"Skip" button on the profile photo screen.

"Welcome Back" -> Login.

"Remember me" is handled on the device (keep the token in secure storage). Check `next_step`: if not `completed`, continue the sign-up.

Send the `idToken` from the google_sign_in package.

New accounts get `next_step = verify_phone` -> use the **Phone (social users)** endpoints, then continue the normal steps.
Send `identityToken` from sign_in_with_apple. Apple gives the name only on the first login, so send `name` when you have it.
Returns a guest token (`next_step = guest`). Guests can browse; ask them to register before booking.
Call on app start when a token is saved. 401 = token invalid -> go to Login. Use `next_step` to resume sign-up.
Call when Firebase refreshes the push token.
Revokes this device token. `fcm_token` optional (stops push to this device).
For Google/Apple accounts with `next_step = verify_phone`. Uses the same phone + OTP screens.
Saves the verified phone and returns `next_step`.
"Forgot Password" -> Send OTP. 422 on `phone` if no account uses this number.
Returns `reset_token` (valid 15 minutes, saved automatically in Postman).

"Update Password" screen in the forgot flow (only New + Confirm password; no current password). Shows "Password Changed" -> Login.

All devices are logged out.
"Update Password" from the profile (Current + New + Confirm). Other devices are logged out; this one stays logged in.
